content.text: Halton Hills fall registration opens Sep 1, 7:00 a.m. for residents (Sep 8 for everyone else) - I'm on it and I'll text you before it opens. The only web find for the fall right now is Tiny Tumblers parent & tot on Saturday mornings, but that's too young for Milo and Ada - their site says no fall schedule is up for older kids yet.
